You: How about instead of buying that mask we just go to eat some expensive burgers, huh?
Bot: We can if you want to, but my receptors are unable to differentiate between good and bad burgers…
You: Oh. Right. I’m sorry, I forgot. 
You: Let’s just walk around a little then…
Damn, she seems kinda down, but I’m sure she will forget about it after some time.
